From 60edfabc7b0fede810ed5fe414fff95f7d6b0944 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Aurelien DARRAGON <adarragon@haproxy.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Feb 2024 11:25:31 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] LICENSE: http_ext: fix GPL license version

This is a followup of the previous commit: GH user @songliumeng initially
reported an issue with the GPL license version for event_hdl source file
which was fixed by the previous commit. It turns out the same mistake was
made in http_ext source file: due to a mixup between LGPL and GPL, GPL
version '2.1' was referenced instead of '2'.

Again, clarify that this is indeed GPL by making use of the banner
provided in doc/gpl.txt

This should be backported in 2.8 with b2bb925 ("MINOR: proxy/http_ext:
introduce proxy forwarded option")

diff --git a/src/http_ext.c b/src/http_ext.c
index a36751931..269a97f5e 100644
--- a/src/http_ext.c
+++ b/src/http_ext.c
@@ -3,11 +3,19 @@

 #include <haproxy/sample.h>
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `src/http_ext.c`**
- The license header has been modified to correct the version of the GNU General Public License (GPL) referenced. 
- The previous reference to "version 2.1 of the License" has been changed to "version 2 of the License."
- Additional clarifications have been added to the license text, including a statement about the lack of warranty and a note on obtaining a copy of the GPL.

### Relationships
- This patch is a follow-up to a previous commit that addressed a similar issue in another source file (`event_hdl`). The changes in `http_ext.c` are part of a broader effort to ensure consistency and correctness in the licensing information across the codebase, specifically addressing the mix-up between LGPL and GPL licenses. The modifications in both files are related as they both aim to rectify the same licensing error reported by the user.

Here is the commit message:
LICENSE: http_ext: fix GPL license version

This is a followup of the previous commit: GH user @songliumeng initially
reported an issue with the GPL license version for event_hdl source file
which was fixed by the previous commit. It turns out the same mistake was
made in http_ext source file: due to a mixup between LGPL and GPL, GPL
version '2.1' was referenced instead of '2'.

Again, clarify that this is indeed GPL by making use of the banner
provided in doc/gpl.txt

This should be backported in 2.8 with b2bb925 ("MINOR: proxy/http_ext:
introduce proxy forwarded option")

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug was a mix-up between the LGPL and GPL licenses, which led to the incorrect reference of "version 2.1" instead of the correct "version 2" in the license header of the source file. This confusion could result in legal implications regarding the distribution and modification of the software, as different versions of the GPL have different terms and conditions.
